item.title: Juneau’s recycling center to open at limited capacity after weekslong closure
item.description: The center will begin accepting only cardboard and mixed paper, and only for this Friday and Saturday from 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

item.title: Newscast: Thursday, Feb. 19, 2026

item.title: Juneau Community Foundation, Tania Lewis talks Bears, and UAS Spring Career Fair
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring Juneau Community Foundation scholarship updates, Tania Lewis offers bear talk, and UAS Spring Career Fair and Networking Dinner.

item.title: Alaska’s Department of Corrections spent $24M over budget last year, mostly on staff overtime
item.description: There were 15 correctional staff who earned over $100,000 each in overtime pay last year, on top of salary and benefits.

item.title: Alaska legislator’s chief of staff arrested on child sex crime charges
item.description: Federal agents arrested Craig Scott Valdez, 36, early Friday in Juneau, according to court documents.

item.title: Is this empty gravel lot about to become downtown Juneau’s newest tourist attraction?
item.description: The development would include three large interactive theaters/rides, a retail store and some office space.

item.title: Juneau school board adds nursing, homeschool positions to proposed budget
item.description: There was no discussion Thursday of adding two positions that the Tlingit Culture, Language and Literacy program could stand to lose when grant funds run out.

item.title: Acoustic Turbulence explores the journey of the soul through a bee’s life cycle
item.description: Hali Duran, who’s been choreographing and dancing in Juneau since 2012, worked with several dancers creating what she calls “a whole new vocabulary.”

item.title: 2025 was Alaska’s 8th hottest year on record
item.description: A new report highlights weather extremes and warmer overall temperatures – two signs of climate change.

item.title: Newscast – Friday, Feb. 20, 2026
item.description: In this newscast: Juneau choreographer Hali Duran explores the six stages of a queen bumblebee's life cycle in Acoustic Turbulence -- a new production of Orpheus Project, showing this weekend; A large gravel lot in the hear of downtown Juneau's tourism corridor has sat empty for years. But that might soon change; In a recent budget meeting, the Juneau School Board discussed adding rather than cutting positions next school year; Alaska saw its eighth hottest year on record last year.
